title: Downstream 2026 election-information distribution from Democracy Works and VIP

data.target: Downstream 2026 election-information distribution from Democracy Works and VIP
data.research_question: Which additional public platforms, election offices, civic organizations, API consumers, embeds, media products, and information-flow paths distribute Democracy Works, Voting Information Project, or related official election data in 2026?
objectives: Enumerate additional named platform and API consumers.
Map state/local election-office data submission and review relationships without collapsing jurisdictions.
Enumerate public embeds, election centers, AI/search surfaces, newsletters, and downstream distribution channels.
Preserve directionality and current versus historical status for each information-flow edge.
hypotheses: Public partner pages and platform election centers will expose additional named downstream consumers and integration paths.
State and local election-office participation in VIP will expose geographically distributed upstream data relationships.
